title: 3 people + AI + 1 month — this is the game we ended up with
author: porroypapitas
selftext:
We’re a team of 3 and we’ve been building **Space Farmers** for about a month using AI heavily throughout the development pipeline.

🎮 **Play it in your browser — no download:**  
[https://nagargames.itch.io/space-farmers](https://nagargames.itch.io/space-farmers)

It’s a co-op PvE game where you farm, gather resources, build defenses, explore a procedural world and fight creatures and bosses.

Our current workflow is roughly:

* Claude → coding / development
* GPT → concepts, visuals and iteration
* Meshy → 2D concepts to 3D
* Unity → integration, gameplay, testing and polish

The video is actual gameplay from the current build.

The interesting part for us has been seeing where AI speeds things up a lot — and where it still needs a ton of human direction and cleanup.

**If you try it, what’s the first thing you’d improve?**

comments.author: RamonDozol
comments.body:
it requires polishing, but its a great start. 

Here are what personaly i would change, but feel free to ignore it. 

1- terrain is too flat, i would add variance and height to it.   
2- Art direction is all over the place, minerals and trees look completely out of place with characters and enemies. pick one style and try to stick to it. ( a color pallet would help, or several scenes of the game recreated following the same art style).   
3- this is part of the above, but the enemies dont look like scyfi, but more fantasy generic.   
If this is an alien world, the enemies look like fantasy elementals instead of aliens, this somewhat breaks immersion for me.   
4- The items that the players collect should also look like simple 3d objects that are parts of the main objects ( cristal shards, wood blocks, etc, only the exp from monsters would be "orbs" but even them i would make something Physical, like DNA samples, or some kind of material that can be used to improove the character or learn new tech.

comments.author: ArtificialImages
comments.body:
If you're spending money on this stop. You're being scammed. 

Spending time on this is bad enough. But money? Thats dangerous. 

I'm a professional game dev, have been for over a decade. And I love ai. 

I could make this single handedly in maybe a week or two. Including all the models and animations. Maybe less than a week even. But I wouldn't, because I wouldn't waste my time.

The quality is bad in every aspect, on every asset, in every sense. The concept is bad. 

Unironically you need help. Not from chat.gpt. from someone who knows what theyre doing. 

And do not spend another penny. 

You need to be careful not to get too drunk ok the idea that you can make games now with ai. 

12 year old pre ai were making better games than this. 

Being able to make a game is meaningless. Being able to make a good game is not. 

You were always capable of making bad games, so nothing has changed for you with the invention of ai. Even with a powerful ai, it can't make up for lack of taste and skill. 

I'm sorry for the harsh words but you need to hear this before spending money or wasting more time on this.

If you want genuine help or advice I'm here. Like I said I'm a game dev.
